estimatedDeliveryToOriginCFSWeekNumber.description: Estimated Delivery To Origin CFS Week Number

estimatedDeliveryToOriginCFS.description: Estimated Delivery To Origin CFS Date

eventCode.description: The unique event code - usually 3 chars, but can be 2 or more.

description.description: A description of the event code.

eventDate.description: The date in which the event happened

eventPlace.description: The place in which the event happened.

eventSource.description: The source system that input the event.

locationType.description: Options - Intermediate / Transit Customs / Destination Customs

dateModified.description: Date the event was modified - in general events cannot be modified but QA issues can be resolved.

userModified.description: User who modified the event - in general events cannot be modified but QA issues can be resolved.

transportMode.description: Mode of Transport eg. Air, Sea, Road

voyageFlight.description: Voyage (MoT Sea) or Flight No (MoT Air)

isMainCarriage.description: Boolean if leg is main leg

numberOfOriginalBills.description: Number of Original Bill of Ladings

numberOfCopyBills.description: Number of Copy Bill of Lading

packType.description: Pack Type (e.g. PACK, PALL, COLL, etc.)

isCancelled.description: N or Y.  This is used to set an order to state cancelled.  This may or may not be accepted, depending on the progress of the order.

orderNumber.description: The unique order number between the buyer and supplier.

splitNumber.description: If the order needs to be shipped or delivered in multiple parts, each part will be assigned a number.  The original order will have a split number of 0, the first split would have 1, second 2, etc

orderDate.description: The date the order is created

goodsDescription.description: A general description of the goods

transportMode.description: The requested transport mode.  Values are: SEA for Oceanfreight", AIR for Airfreight, ROAD for Roadfreight and COU for Courier/Express

containerMode.description: This is the container mode, in which the Order must be shipped.  For Orders, as the future consolidation state is not known, this will normally be set to 'LCL'

serviceLevel.description: Usually a three char code.  Service Levels are specific to your organisation.  Please see your Account Manager for details.

estimatedExWorksDate.description: The date the supplier has estimated the cargo will depart the factory.

actualExWorksDate.description: The data the order actually departed the factory.

requiredExWorks.description: The date the buyer requests the supplier dispatch the order from the factory.

requiredInStore.description: The date the buyer requests the order be delivered to destination door.

originCountry.description: The product country of origin - not necessarily where the product is collected from.

incoterm.description: The International Commercial Terms, agreed between buyer and supplier.

additionalTerms.description: The UNLOCO of the additional terms or named placed.

additionalTermsUNLOCO.description: The date the buyer requests the supplier dispatch the order from the factory.

actualVolume.description: The total volume of the order.

unitOfVolume.description: The unit related to the total volume.

actualWeight.description: The total weight of the order.

unitOfWeight.description: The unit related to the total volume.

totalPacks.description: The total number of packages related to the order.

totalQuantity.description: The total number of skus related to the order.

followUpDate.description: A date in which the Control Tower should follow up with the Supplier

portOfLoading.description: The requested port of loading, in UNLOCO.

portOfDischarge.description: The requested port of discharge, in UNLOCO.

currency.description: The currency related to the order value.

totalInners.description: Total number of inner packages requested to be within the order.

totalOuters.description: Total number of outer packages requested to be within the order.

source.description: The source of the order entry: WEB = manually entered, API, EDI.  This is automatically set.

systemID.description: A uuid/guid accociated with the order.  This is only for scenarios where a third party order management platform is managing the order.

transitWarehouse.description: This value is only populated if the Supplier is delivering directly to our warehouse/CFS, without a Booking.

onHandDate.description: This date is only populated if the Supplier is delivering directly to our warehouse/CFS, without a Booking.

plannerCode.description: The code associated with person who is the order's assigned buyer/procurement code.

plannerEmail.description: The email address associated with person who is the order's assigned buyer/procurement code.

warehouseReceiptNumber.description: This value is only populated if the Supplier is delivering directly to our warehouse/CFS, without a Booking.

vehicleRegistration.description: This value is only populated if the Supplier is delivering directly to our warehouse/CFS, without a Booking.

trailerNumber.description: This value is only populated if the Supplier is delivering directly to our warehouse/CFS, without a Booking.

seal.description: This value is only populated if the Supplier is delivering directly to our warehouse/CFS, without a Booking.

manifestNumber.description: This value is only populated if the Supplier is delivering directly to our warehouse/CFS, without a Booking.

invoiceDate.description: The invoice date associated with the Order.

invoiceNumber.description: The invoice number associated with the Order.

confirmedDate.description: For scenarios that require a confirmation of the order before it can be booked, the date of confirmation will populate this field.

confirmationNumber.description: For scenarios that require a confirmation of the order before it can be booked, the confirmation authorisation number will populate this field.

freightCost.description: For customers using the Landed Cost functionality, this value will show the proportion of the freight cost.

landedCost.description: For customers using the Landed Cost functionality, this value will show the proportion of the Landed Cost, which is SKU cost, plus Freight Cost

contractNumber.description: The contract number between buyer and supplier, associated with the Order.

goodsReceiptNumber.description: The final destination warehouse, goods receipt number. This comes from the customer, unless DSV Manages the destination stock control.

goodsReceiptDate.description: The final destination warehouse, goods receipt date. This comes from the customer, unless DSV Manages the destination stock control.

authorisedBy.description: The person within the customer/other authorised party authorises the Order to be shipped.

authorisedToShip.description: The date in which the customer/other authorised party authorises the Order to be shipped.

system.description: If the system integration is required to use the source/downstream system's GUID, it can be populated here.

orderType.description: PO, SO, STO, BPO, CO.  This should be defined by your implementation manager within DSV

orderTypeDescription.description: Full description of Order Type, such as Purchase Order for PO.

parentOrderNumber.description: If this order is a 'call off', this value will be the blanket purchase order number.

revisionNumber.description: This is provided by the customer, to indicate the order's revision number, if it has been revised.

earliestShipDate.description: Earliest Date the cargo should depart from Port

latestShipDate.description: Latest Date the cargo should depart from Port

customFields.description: Fields that can be defined by the user

notes.description: Any notes that may have been added by the customer, supplier or DSV.

dateModified.description: The date the order was modified in system

userModified.description: The user or service that last modified the order

dateCreated.description: The date the order was created in system

userCreated.description: The user or service that created the order

lineStatus.description: Line Status: PLC for Placed, DLV for Delivered.

lineNo.description: Order Line Number.  Must be an integer, unique to the respective Order.

partno.description: Part No, Product Code or SKU Number.

unitOfQuantity.description: The unit, such as: EA = Each.

qtyInvoiced.description: Quantity Invoiced / Booked by the Supplier.

qtyBooked.description: Quantity Invoiced / Booked by the Supplier.

qtyReceived.description: Quantity Received at the destination warehouse.

qtyShipped.description: Quantity checked by the Control Tower to actually be Booked.

quantityRemaining.description: Only applicable for Blanket Purchase Orders.

volume.description: The total volume of the Order.

weight.description: The total weight of the Order.

linePrice.description: Price of the line, which is the the individual item, times the number of pieces

dimUnit.description: Unit of Dimension, applicable to the Length, Width and Height

firstPortETD.description: First Port Estimated Time of Departure

firstPortATD.description: First Port Actual Time of Departure

lastPortETA.description: Last Port Estimated Time of Departure

lastPortATA.description: Last Port Actual Time of Departure
